_readme: Settings for the /prospect skill. Edit and save; the next run uses them. Keys starting with _ are comments.

input_columns._help: Leave these blank to auto-detect from the scraper file's headers. To force one, put the exact header text, e.g. "business_name": "title".

filters._help: Applied in this order. Every dropped row is listed with its reason on the 'Filtered out' tab. Rows are never sorted.

research._help: parallel_agents = how many businesses are researched at once. max_attempts_per_row = retries before a row is flagged for manual research.

emails._help: Extra mailbox names to always treat as generic (BUSINESS E-MAIL ADDRESS column), e.g. ["lettings", "valuations"].

setup._help: Filled in by the setup interview (/prospect setup). Your personal answers live in ~/.prospect/, never in this folder.

browser._help: Browser used for Facebook (and optional LinkedIn) checks: built-in (Claude desktop app), chrome (Claude in Chrome) or none.
browser.name: none

linkedin._help: browser_lookups: also look people up on LinkedIn in the logged-in browser when Google finds no marketing/owner contact. Off by default. daily_limit keeps volume low to protect the account.

outreach._help: Email writing. mode: off, draft (Gmail drafts you review and send) or send (Claude sends after you confirm each batch). daily_limit counts drafts + sends per day across all runs.

sheets._help: mode: manual (you import the .xlsx into Google Sheets) or connector (Claude writes each run into the Google Sheet below as new tabs; needs the Google Sheets connector).

output._help: Column order for each tab. Rename/reorder freely; header_fields says what goes in each header. A header not listed in header_fields becomes an empty column.
